text:
Ana: quick sync: proposal for a compact resume token to unify paging + streaming across SDKs.
Luis: +1. current tokens are huge and break URLs.
Tara: what fields are mandatory? model_id, offset/seq, version?
Ana: MVP: version byte | model short id | offset (varint) | 4 byte crc32 | optional hmac. base64url encode whole blob. keeps token <= ~64 bytes typical.
Ben: SDK surface: iterator exposes .pause() -> token str; constructors accept resume=token. Python/TS use str, Go use type ResumeToken string.
Luis: transport: paged HTTP -> ?cursor=token, streaming -> resume_token header on reconnect. both must accept same format.
Tara: error mapping: server returns RESUME_EXPIRED with hint -> SDK throws ResumeExpired error with hint; malformed -> InvalidResumeToken. network -> transient retry.
Ana: metrics: token_size_bytes, resume_attempts, resume_success.
Ben: security: hosted default unsigned for inspectability; private can enable kms_signing to require hmac. SDK debug.parse(token, allow_debug=true) prints internals only when allowed.
infra-bot: ci: added resume-token-format spec check to pre-submit.
Luis: next step: Ana to write 1-page spec, Tara will prototype Python + TS helpers, Ben covers Go. aim to land EOW.
